messages: Hannah (People Ops): Quick coordination: Jules just had a baby and needs dependent passport + H-4 addition. We need to ship original passport + birth certificate to counsel for H-4 consular processing. Can we confirm what docs counsel needs and who will handle courier? :baby:

Jules (New Hire): Thanks! We're in a rush  baby arrived last week. I have the baby's passport application receipt and original hospital birth certificate. I don't have a passport yet for the baby. Can counsel start the H-4 while passport pending?

Sumi (Immig Legal): Congrats Jules! Short answer: we need the dependent's passport to complete consulate packet. Counsel can prepare the H-4 paperwork and hold until passport is issued, but turnaround for passport depends on country. Please upload scans of birth certificate + parent's passport + child's passport application receipt. Notarization not needed for initial packet. Link: https://redwood.internal/legal/immigration/dependent-checklist.pdf
Jules (New Hire): Uploaded scans to Ripley. ETA for passport is ~10 business days via expedited service. Should I still send originals of the parent's passport now?

Hannah (People Ops): Yes please send originals of parent's passport and child's birth certificate for evidence. Counsel will wait on child's passport and then courier later. We'll cover two shipments (outbound and return).

Logan (Facilities): Reception can accept envelope. Please label "Immigration - Sumi" and include a signed drop-off receipt. Reception hours 8:30-6:00. We can schedule DHL pickup same day if you drop by before 2pm.
Jules (New Hire): I can drop by 1:45 today. Do I include a pre-paid return envelope?

Sumi (Immig Legal): Yes, include a pre-paid return label for secure courier. We'll also need a signed parental consent affidavit (template in link) notarized for the child's international travel after stamping (not required for courier now).

Hannah (People Ops): Action items: 1) Jules to drop originals at reception 1:45; 2) Hannah to create DHL prepaid outbound label and DM it to Jules; 3) Sumi to add docket entry and note pending child passport. Tag expenses "immigration-shipping". :white_check_mark:
ExpensifyBot (bot): Expense template created: "immigration-shipping-1799954321". Upload receipts within 14 days for reimbursement.
Logan (Facilities): Received DHL booking request. Pickup scheduled 2:15pm. Tracking: DHL-BABY-2026-7788. Reception will hold until courier picks up.

Sumi (Immig Legal): Logged shipment DHL-BABY-2026-7788. Counsel expects materials 2026-04-14. Docket ref: H4-DEPENDENT-JULES-2026. We'll update when child's passport arrives and we can complete consular packet.
Jules (New Hire): Dropped package at 1:40, reception gave me receipt. Thanks everyone  will upload courier receipt now.

Hannah (People Ops): Thanks team. Jules, when child's passport arrives, DM Sumi and we'll coordinate the second secure shipment. Also reminder: attach receipts to Expensify and tag 'immigration-shipping'.
